scope.note: Read-only static audit; corrections applied after review.

version_metadata.name: bt_version_metadata
version_metadata.boundary_evidence: NUL-terminated version string immediately before the first HCI command; 32 bytes including NUL.

hcd.name: bt_hcd_patchram
hcd.boundary_evidence: Strict HCI command stream parsed with scapy 2.8.0 HCI_Command_Hdr: every record has a valid 3-byte header and matching length; 166 vendor Write_RAM (0xFC4C) records, one final Launch_RAM (0xFC4E). Ends immediately after Launch_RAM; following bytes do not belong to this strict stream.
hcd.trailing_note: Bytes after the terminal Launch_RAM are not part of the strict FC4C/FC4E stream and are not extracted.

bt_hcd.classification: Broadcom Bluetooth HCI vendor Write_RAM patchram stream (HCD-style), not WLAN.

format_validation.linux_hcd_compatibility: unproven; raw HCI command stream starts directly with vendor FC4C and has no initial Reset

bt4_1.note: Part of a Write_RAM payload written by the HCD stream; it is not a separate WLAN module header.

range.name: wlan_near_identical_candidate
range.boundary_evidence: 607,868 of 607,872 bytes match PDI 0x4904d4-0x524b54; 4 tail bytes differ (main 836b5f8c, PDI 00000000). This is a repeated near-identical window, NOT a byte-identical payload and NOT a proven image boundary; no main .data pointer/loader was found.
range.architecture_observation: Thumb/Thumb-2 instruction samples; exact CPU/architecture unproven.
range.loader_evidence: No 32-bit pointer to 0x91b798/0x920000/0x950000 in main .data/.text; no loader found.

pdi.note: The PDI contains separate Broadcom WLAN material. These distant strings do NOT classify the local 0x8411c8 block, which is BT HCD based on the strict HCI parse. Full PDI function analysis is out of scope.

limitations: The BT HCD stream is strictly HCI-header/length/opcode validated, but Linux .hcd compatibility is not proven (no initial Reset; raw vendor stream).
Bytes after the terminal Launch_RAM are excluded; they may contain other data/commands but are outside the verified stream.
The 607,872-byte WLAN range is a near-identical candidate, not a byte-identical payload; 4 tail bytes differ and no loader/start proof exists.
WLAN version/NVRAM/patch-table records have exact local boundaries but do not prove the surrounding image boundary.
AAC remains unmapped; descriptors only, no boundary/loader.
No camera, network, remote-control, flashing or external transmission was performed.
